notes.title: Holy Potatoes! I'm A Hero?! Demo is available now (out of nowhere)!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38073166/97ea858329aa82187544958313dd9cac9a113bfd.png[/img]

Hey Spudlings,

Long time no see. 
We have been quite busy with our development but finally, we are very excited to show you a new demo for our latest game, [b]Holy Potatoes! I'm A Hero?![/b].

[h2]What is the game about?[/h2]
[b]Holy Potatoes! I'm A Hero?![/b] is a wacky action RPG where YOU'RE the hero! Cook, craft, and toss around epic weapons, barrels of poison, and more as you fulfil your destiny!

[h2]What can you expect from the demo?[/h2]
This is a short demo to showcase our combat mechanics in the game. This demo covers roughly 40% of the mechanics planned for [b]Holy Potatoes! I'm A Hero?![/b].
Since some of the mechanics are missing from the demo, you can refer to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1299040/discussions/0/2450469601582373772/]FAQs[/url] for more information.

For any suggestion for us to improve the game further, please do not hesitate to provide your feedback [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeXfRV_bT45Cbhlsi4sPO6RdyqQ8yBRourmoO3L_JXp4yPiFg/viewform]here[/url] or reach out to us directly through our Discord channel.

If you have enjoyed playing our demo, don't forget to add it to your Wishlist!

Have fun playing!!

[b] Daylight Studios [/b]
